review.summary: The round-2 finding is fixed by a documentation-only commit that adds Prettier to the Frontend section's technology list in ARCHITECTURE.md and to the task's Documentation section. Every current frontend tech-stack and tool list now names Prettier: the stack lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md, the ARCHITECTURE.md Frontend technology list, the docs/TESTING.md tool list, and the ADR-001 Decision and Consequences sections. The remaining ESLint-only mentions are the historical ADR-001 Options Considered list, linting prose in docs/TESTING.md and past QA results, which need no change. No new issues were found; lint, tests and build were not rerun for this documentation-only commit and passed on the reviewed implementation.
